what: The ambient parked and moving cars are low-poly, flat-shaded boxes: estates and minivans with faceted panels, flat disc rims, no glazing depth and almost no lamp detail. The Föli bus is a bare yellow box with a black band, flat grey disc wheels and no doors, mirrors or lights. At street level these are the most obvious CG giveaway, made worse by sitting next to the excellent procedural G-Classes.
where: Lemminkäisenkatu, KartaView spot k8 at (-41, 1.11, 8) heading 146: <scratch>/qa-campus-ext/r1/k8-1100.png. Junction with the bus: …/r1/k5-1530.png. fix:
In props/vehicles.ts:
- Give the traffic models bevelled body slabs (RoundedBox per section), a separate inset glasshouse and proper wheel and tyre geometry with rims (a cheap variant of the G-Class wheel).
- Add lamp clusters and number-plate recesses, and reuse the clear-coat paint parameters from the display cars.
- Model the Föli bus with door leaves, windscreen and mirrors, an LED destination display and wheel arches.
- Keep everything instanced to stay within 30 draw calls.

what: Every time change that alters crowdPlan() re-runs assign() with a PRNG seeded by the new walker count, so all pedestrians are re-drawn on new paths. People pop in and out and jump along the colonnade on a 3-minute step, even with reduced motion. While dragging the slider this happens on Fri 14:00–15:18 and 17:00–17:36, and also Fri 19:00–21:00, Sat 07:30–09:30 and 18:30–22:00, and Sun 12:30–15:30.
where: Street camera (-10,1.7,-75 → -60,8,0) at Fri 17:12, 17:15, 17:18, 17:21 (reduced motion); campus:arrival at 15:00–15:15; desktop high. <scratch>/tod-r1/shots/crop-ppl-grid.png, .../shots/m-ppl.png
fix: Make the assignment stable: seed each walker's path and phase once by its index. On a plan change, only change activeWalkers (fading the added or removed walkers over about 1 s) and adjust the inbound share by flipping a few walkers' direction, without reshuffling the existing ones.
